summary: Girls' 14&U singles 2023 Wimbledon Championships Final Champion Luna Vujović Runner-up Hollie Smart Score 6–3, 6–1 Events Singles men women boys girls Doubles men women mixed boys girls WC Singles men women quad WC Doubles men women quad ← 2022 · Wimbledon Championships · 2024 → 2023 tennis event results Main article: 2023 Wimbledon Championships It was the second edition of this discipline. Romania's Alexia Ioana Tatu was the defending champion and was still eligible to participate in the tournament but chose not to play. [ 1 ] She did not return to play in the girls' singles event either. Serbia's Luna Vujović won the title by defeating Hollie Smart from Great Britain in straight sets. [ 2 ] Format [ edit ] The first phase of the tournament saw four round-robin groups compete. The winners of each group advanced to the semi-finals. The rest competed in a consolation play-off tournament.
